Comfort update (2026-11-15): match.mp3 now uses Kenney drop_004.ogg;
win.mp3 uses confirmation_001.ogg from the same CC0 archive above.
Edits: low-pass filter (1600/2000 Hz), short fades, duration cap and peak limiting;
transcoded to MP3 96 kbps. No synthesized sounds. Selection, invalid-move and
landing recordings are no longer played; music is unchanged.
